annotations.title: Website opportunity assessment for a supplied URL

description: Assess an existing business website supplied by the caller (not lead discovery). One plain HTTP fetch (no browser) produces SEO and security-header findings, static accessibility signals, platform and marketing tags, domain mail setup (MX, SPF, DMARC), company profile, and a 0-100 website opportunity score with suggested outreach hooks. Input: url; optional business_name. Does not find prospects, contact details, or verify buying intent. $0.25 per call. Returns: url, business_name, domain, site{final_url, status, https, redirected, response_time_ms, content_type, bytes, title}, seo{pass, checks, findings[]}, security{pass, checks, findings[]}, accessibility_signals{images_total, images_without_alt, html_lang, html_lang_present, inputs_total, inputs_without_label, links_total, links_without_text, scope, full_audit}, tech{platform, generator, server, powered_by, analytics[], ad_pixels[], chat_widgets[], has_analytics, has_ad_pixel, has_chat, source}, email_domain{domain, exists, mx_present, mx[], mail_provider, spf, dmarc}, company{name, legal_name, description, website, founded, employees, industries[], headquarters, socials, identifiers, sources[], notes[]}, score, score_band, reasons[], score_breakdown[{rule, points, detail}], score_rule, sections_failed[], sources[], notes[], checked_at.

business_name.description: The business's name, to help the company lookup. Optional.

language.description: Optional BCP-47 language tag (en, ja, ko, pt-BR): the human-readable strings of the result (notes, details, reasons) are translated into this language; data, codes, numbers and URLs are untouched. Default: as produced.
